In this file, we will quickly view the locations
``` {python}
# Package Import
import folium
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd

# Data Import
city_info = pd.read_csv("../data/city_info.csv")
```

Build a quick map to view the locations:

``` {python}
map_center = [city_info['Lat'].mean(), city_info['Lon'].mean()]
m = folium.Map(location=map_center, zoom_start=4)

# Add weather stations points to map
for _, row in city_info.iterrows():
    folium.Marker(
        location=[row['Lat'], row['Lon']],
        popup=row['Name']
    ).add_to(m)

# View map
m

# Save map to use in the presentation
#m.save("../figures/city_map_full_us.html")
```

Combining this map with NOAA storm track information:
``` {python}
#| echo: false

```

we can see that we can filter out all weather stations west of Kansas City, and north of Detroit.
